data.one_liner: Simulates how a Flutter app looks and behaves on various devices and configurations.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that wraps your app to emulate different screen sizes, orientations, locales, and system settings. It keeps the app state and offers plugin hooks for screenshots and file exploration.
use_when: Testing UI on multiple device form factors without physical devices
Demonstrating app appearance to stakeholders during development
avoid_when: Need precise performance metrics from real hardware
strengths: Fast visual feedback across many device profiles
Keeps app state while switching devices
weaknesses: Cannot replace testing on actual devices for performance or native behavior
Limited to UI simulation, not full device capabilities
